description: arbeitsplan: denies a re-dispatch of an identical prompt, a write to the shared tree during a fan-out phase, a write outside the declared writeScope, and a dispatch past the declared budget. type:command, never type:prompt -- a prompt hook asks a model to decide, and a model asked whether it may retry is the thing being governed. Ordering is NOT gated here; that is takt's job, via the beats arbeitsplan-compile writes. Inert until analysis/arbeitsplan/run_scope.json exists.
